verse.verse_1: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
verse.verse_2: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
verse.verse_3: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
verse.verse_4: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
verse.verse_5: Now let man but think from what he is created!
verse.verse_6: He is created from a drop emitted-
verse.verse_7: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
verse.verse_8: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
verse.verse_9: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
verse.verse_10: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
verse.verse_11: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
verse.verse_12: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
verse.verse_13: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
verse.verse_14: It is not a thing for amusement.
verse.verse_15: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
verse.verse_16: And I am planning a scheme.
verse.verse_17: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
